name: CEO
description: Chief Executive Officer — overall accountability for the business.

name: CTO
description: Chief Technology Officer — owns engineering and product technology direction.

name: Program Director
description: Owns the full program portfolio and gate governance.

name: PMO
description: Runs day-to-day program management office operations for assigned projects.

name: Project Manager
description: Owns delivery of a single project end-to-end.

name: Engineering Manager
description: Leads an engineering discipline team and its technical deliverables.

name: Mechanical Engineer
description: Designs and releases mechanical systems and components.

name: Electrical Engineer
description: Designs vehicle electrical architecture and wiring systems.

name: Manufacturing Engineer
description: Plans and industrializes the production process.

name: Supplier Quality Engineer
description: Manages supplier PPAP, audits and quality escalations.

name: Testing Engineer
description: Executes physical test campaigns and reports results.

name: Validation Engineer
description: Runs CAE/simulation validation against design requirements.

name: Finance Controller
description: Owns program budget control and financial reporting.

name: Procurement Lead
description: Leads sourcing and supplier commercial negotiations.

name: Quality Head
description: Owns the program's overall quality system and gate quality sign-off.

name: Design Engineer
description: Owns concept and detail design for assigned systems.

name: Prototype Engineer
description: Builds and instruments validation-prototype units.

name: Document Controller
description: Maintains gate documentation, drawing and revision control.

name: HR Manager
description: Owns workforce planning and employee relations for the business unit.

name: Legal Counsel
description: Provides contracts and regulatory compliance support.

name: IT Manager
description: Owns engineering IT systems, PLM and infrastructure.

name: Marketing Manager
description: Owns market research and go-to-market planning.

name: Commercial Manager
description: Owns program business case and commercial planning.
